_note: size_m = [x width, y depth, z height] in metres, Blender axes (Godot: x, z, y). Fronts face Blender -Y (Godot +Z). Origin on the ground at the footprint centre unless origin says centre. collision null = walk-through / no blocking footprint.

props.name: wishing_well
props.notes: Round well of mossy grey stones with water inside, leaf-shingle roof on two posts, crank (+X side) with rope and a wooden bucket. Front faces -Y. marker_ring on the ground in front (-Y).

props.name: mushroom_cottage
props.notes: Mushroom house: red cap with cream spots, cream stem walls, round wooden door with a step on the front (-Y), two round glowing windows (bright yellow faces), chimney at the back right, flowers at the base. marker_ring on the ground in front of the door.

props.name: market_stall
props.notes: Wooden market stall, counter faces -Y. Green-and-cream striped awning on four posts, sign with a golden leaf, wicker baskets of apples, carrots (two more carrots lie on the counter for the hare) and turnips. marker_ring on the ground in front of the counter.
